description: This file defines enums, a class interface, and includes related to 5G network measurement metrics (E2SM KPM). It specifies metric levels, labels, and a measurement provider interface for supporting network measurement data collection and support checks.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_meas_provider
classes.description: Abstract interface class for providing network measurement data and support checks.

methods.name: ~e2sm_kpm_meas_provider
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the measurement provider interface.

methods.name: get_supported_metric_names
methods.description: Returns a list of supported metric names for a given level.

methods.name: is_cell_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific cell global ID is supported.

methods.name: is_ue_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific UE ID is supported.

methods.name: is_test_cond_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific test condition type is supported.

methods.name: is_metric_supported
methods.description: Checks if a metric with specific labels, level, and cell scope is supported.

methods.name: get_ues_matching_test_conditions
methods.description: Retrieves UE IDs matching certain test conditions.

methods.name: get_ues_matching_test_conditions
methods.description: Retrieves UE IDs matching certain UE-specific test conditions.

methods.name: get_meas_data
methods.description: Collects measurement data for a specified metric, labels, UEs, and cell scope.
